dataQualityPolicy: No inferred publication dates. Unknown historical source publication stays null; corrected-history sensitivity experiments are separate from strictly point-in-time qualified forecasts.

NBA rebound share per observed missed-shot opportunity can outperform per-minute rebound weights.
NBA rebounds cannot be credited after a modeled period-ending shot at the buzzer.
Chronological opportunity/efficiency point models should be compared against rolling means before full-game promotion.
